nature_language: 当前位置南京。我和朋友计划去重庆玩两天，选择火车出行，想吃火锅，预算3700元，开一间双床房。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Nanjing. My friend and I are planning to visit Chongqing for two days. We have chosen to travel by train and want to eat hot pot. Our budget is 3,700 RMB, and we plan to book a twin room. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
